entries.subject: the Maldives
entries.object: a British protectorate in 1887 and a republic in 1968

spans.text:
### Background

A sultanate since the 12th century, the Maldives became a British protectorate in 1887 and a republic in 1968, three years after independence.

entries.description: Abdul GAYOOM dominated Maldives' political scene for 30 years
entries.subject: Abdul GAYOOM

spans.text: President Maumoon Abdul GAYOOM dominated Maldives' political scene for 30 years, elected to six successive terms by single-party referendums.

entries.object: defeated in a runoff by Mohamed NASHEED

spans.text: GAYOOM was defeated in a runoff by Mohamed NASHEED, a political activist whom the regime had jailed several years earlier.

entries.object: the presidency and handed over power to Vice President Mohammed WAHEED Hassan Maniku

spans.text: In 2012, after several weeks of street protests in response to a top judge's arrest, NASHEED resigned the presidency and handed over power to Vice President Mohammed WAHEED Hassan Maniku.
